goal: Elevate Requirements, Tests, and Acceptance Criteria evidence to first-class Agile work products with their own workflow states, authority boundaries, and Cockpit surfaces.
notes: Open design question, blocking acceptance criteria: requirements already carry verified and validated states. If those denote human acceptance in the same sense as Task verification, they must be Human-only in the authority table. This decision shapes most of the Epic's scope and is the user's to make.

This Epic subsumes the dashboard-tile request for Requirements, Plans, and Tests. Once these are work items, tiles follow from the existing AirframeDashboardStatusSummary builder rather than needing a parallel tile type.

Related defect found 2026-09-05: narrative fields are frequently empty in canonical records (Task rationale empty in 147/191, Epic goal in 10/25, Sprint goal in 6/45), so detail views render blank sections. Worth deciding whether these are required fields under the new model.
outOfScope: Changing human-only verification boundaries for existing Task, Issue, Sprint, and Epic kinds.
Cache payload de-duplication, which is tracked separately as T-0199.
AICockpit read-primitive work, which is tracked separately as T-0190.
rationale: Requirements, Tests, and AC evidence already behave as work products: they are canonical records with lifecycle states, they trace to Epics and Tasks, and they gate release. They are not AirframeWorkItemKind, so they receive second-class treatment in the dashboard, the workflow tables, and the authority model. The gap also costs tokens: an agent reasoning about requirement or test state must reconstruct it from traceability matrices and generated documents because no first-class workflow surface exists.
scope: Extend AirframeWorkItemKind, or introduce an equivalent abstraction, to cover requirements, tests, and evidence.
Define workflow states and Agent/Human authority for each new kind, and record them in the AGENTS.md authority table.
Surface the new kinds in AgileCockpit dashboard tiles and drill-down, reusing the existing tile builder.
Extend AICockpit list/inspect/status commands to the new kinds.
Migrate canonical state and the cache payload to carry the new kinds without duplicating existing records.
Tie AC objective evidence to acceptance criteria so verification is inspectable from one surface.

workItem.title: First-Class Requirements, Tests, and Evidence Work Products
